Priya Diallo
priya.diallo717@example.com | New York, NY
Priya Diallo has 6 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Meridian Dynamics (2025-2026), where they
owned the Kafka event pipeline processing 35M events/day. Before that, Backend
Engineer at Crestline Infrastructure (2020-2025). Education: M.S. Computer
Engineering, University of Maryland, 2020; B.S. Computer Engineering,
University of Utah, 2017. Core skills: Python, Node.js, REST API design, AWS,
TypeScript, Java, Distributed systems, PostgreSQL, Go, Kafka, System design.
